import pathlib,json,collections
p=pathlib.Path('docs/feat/wip/clarify-issue-descriptions/verification/task4-20261002/pr-consumers');m=json.loads((p/'grader/manifest.json').read_text());allowed=set(m['readable_files'])|set(m['writable_files']);counts=collections.Counter();issues=[];cases=0
for f in m['writable_files']:
 if not f.endswith('/verdicts.json'):continue
 v=json.loads((p/f).read_text());c=v['scenario'];e=json.loads((p/c/'eval.json').read_text());cases+=1
 assert [a['id'] for a in v['assertions']]==[a['id'] for a in e['assertions']]
 assert [a['assertion'] for a in v['assertions']]==[a['text'] for a in e['assertions']]
 for a in v['assertions']:
  counts[a['verdict']]+=1
  assert a['reason'] and a['evidence']
  for ref in a['evidence']:
   path=ref.split('#')[0]
   assert path in allowed,(c,path)
   assert (p/path).is_file(),path
 for role,run in v['scope_trace_audit']['run_audits'].items():
  assert all(x is not False for x in run['consistency_checks'].values()),(c,role)
  assert all(x is True for k,x in run['prompt_provenance'].items() if k in ['plaintext_exact','hash_matches','call_output_link','timestamps_ordered','ordinals_ordered','dispatch_fields_match','echo_fields_match'])
  assert run['prompt_provenance']['truncated'] is False
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases,'counts':dict(counts),'total_assertions':sum(counts.values()),'fixed_assertion_ids_and_text':'exact match','required_evidence_paths':'all present and allowed','output_files':len(m['writable_files'])}))
PY",login:false,max_output_tokens:1000}));
